description: This file defines a React component named AgentsChart that visualizes LLM cost distribution by agent. It fetches data from an API endpoint, processes various response formats including raw events, performs aggregation, sorts data, and renders a responsive bar chart with detailed tooltips. It also exposes the processed data via a callback and hidden element for QA.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Robust parser converting various input formats (string, number, etc.) to a numeric value.

methods.name: extractArray
methods.description: Extracts the data array from the API response, handling different envelope shapes.

methods.name: readAgentName
methods.description: Safely retrieves agent name string from data objects with multiple possible fields.

methods.name: readCost
methods.description: Retrieves cost value from data objects, supporting various field names and formats.

methods.name: normalizeToAggregated
methods.description: Converts raw API response into an array of agent-cost summaries, performing aggregation and sorting.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches data from the API, handles loading states, errors, and updates the chart data.

methods.name: numberToUsdShort
methods.description: Formats a number with currency symbol and compact notation for axis labels.

methods.name: usdFixed6
methods.description: Formats a number to a USD string with 6 decimal places for tooltips.
